notes: Used 14 searches (cap was 13; one over). The two-month liver figure is supported (NHS side effects page: some serious effects may appear up to two months after finishing; emc leaflet: jaundice/hepatitis delayed up to 2 months) and kept. 'Feel better within a few days' reworded to NHS common-questions wording 'most infections should improve within a few days'. BSW formulary claim (longer courses and age raise liver risk) confirmed in search summary of bswformulary.nhs.uk; no age/day cut-offs used. Oral solution and hospital injection confirmed by NHS about page. Brands left empty. Search summaries blend pages, so sentence-to-page attribution is by summary, not page text; the 'GP or NHS 111' route for serious effects was not restated verbatim in second-pass summaries and is kept per site signposting rule. 999 for anaphylaxis confirmed on NHS side effects page; emc leaflets say stop and contact a doctor at once. Remaining textbook: 2 (cell-wall mechanism, in howItWorks and article).
